categories.title: Categories to scrape
categories.description: List of Sbazar.cz top-level categories to scrape (category seoName values, e.g. '1-auto-moto'). Leave empty to scrape all 12. A category with more offers than the site pages through (~10,000) is scraped via its subcategories and price bands.

maxListings.title: Maximum listings per category
maxListings.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape per category (0 = unlimited, the default: every listing)

includeDetailedData.title: Include detailed data
includeDetailedData.description: Whether to scrape detailed information from individual listing pages (description, seller, JSON-LD data)

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Optional search term to filter listings

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Optional location to filter listings (e.g. 'Praha', 'Brno'); converted to the site's ASCII URL slug ('Slaný' -> 'slany'). If sbazar does not accept it the run fails instead of scraping unfiltered listings.

priceMin.title: Minimum price (CZK)
priceMin.description: Minimum price filter in Czech Koruna (inclusive; sbazar also returns 'Dohodou' offers)

priceMax.title: Maximum price (CZK)
priceMax.description: Maximum price filter in Czech Koruna (inclusive; sbazar also returns 'Dohodou' offers)

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Sbazar.cz (Seznam) returns HTTP 404 to datacenter and non-Czech IPs, so this Actor needs a Czech residential proxy to work on the Apify platform. Defaults to Apify Proxy residential IPs located in Czechia.
